name: mycrew
description: mycrew — a five-layer harness for Claude Code, each layer built on the one below. 1) mycrew-tools gives you the primitives and the house rules. 2) mycrew-pipeline is the build pipeline that carries a task from a decision to hardened code. 3) mycrew-worker is the executor that drives the pipeline on one project. 4) mycrew-product is the product plane — what the product must do and how it is built, drawn out of you and written down in one place. 5) mycrew-chief sits on top as your deputy: it shapes that plane and orchestrates workers across the sub-projects. Install mycrew-tools first.

plugins.name: mycrew-tools
plugins.description: Layer 1/5 — primitives. Small, project-agnostic skills you or the model reach for while working: /slap resets a stuck fix, /likec4 draws C4 architecture-as-code, /reminder pins one rule file as a hard constraint, /retract hunts down information declared wrong and surgically removes it. Also ships the harness's rule files (rules/) to copy into a project's .claude/rules/. The primitives every layer above builds on.

plugins.name: mycrew-pipeline
plugins.description: Layer 2/5 — the build pipeline. Five stage skills that carry one task from a decision to hardened code: /how-to-do (decide a fork), /do (build it by a tight set of writing rules), then /refactor, /review, /test to harden and ship it. Skills only. Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-worker.

plugins.name: mycrew-worker
plugins.description: Layer 3/5 — the executor. Hand /worker one piece of work (a fix, a change, a feature, a question) and it carries it to the end: every fork inside that work it settles itself, splitting the job across its own subagents when that pays — and it never widens the brief. Anything outside comes back as a flag in its report, in plain human language, and so does anything the design got wrong: it builds to the plane and never writes it. Runs inline as /worker or as a native subagent the chief dispatches. Built on mycrew-pipeline + mycrew-tools.

plugins.name: mycrew-product
plugins.description: Layer 4/5 — the product plane: everything true about the whole product, in one repository above the sub-projects. /product-init founds it (the folder holding your sub-project repos becomes its own git repo, with a North Star drawn from you). Two endless modes then draw the product out of you and file each affirmed piece where it lives: /braindump listens while you unload and never steers, /ask-me questions you one angle at a time until the product is thought through. Both are strictly extractive — your vision and never its own; propose-idea is the one counterpart, inventing a feature, pitching it with the case for it, and filing it only on your approval. The plane's two views and the rules they obey live here: product-view for docs/product/ (what the product must do, the work no feature covers, what was settled and why) and design-view for docs/design/ (the one model.c4 tree and the technical choices beside it). Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-chief.

plugins.name: mycrew-chief
plugins.description: Layer 5/5 — the top layer, the human's deputy over the whole product. /chief reads the plane the product layer holds — what the product must do and how it is built — shapes it as the human's deputy, decomposes an approved feature into per-repo assignments, picks what to advance next (what-to-do), gates a plan before it becomes code (premortem — assume it shipped and failed, GO or NO-GO), and sequences and dispatches workers as native subagents (worker-orchestration). It never decides what the product should do — that stays the human's — and it never writes code. It conducts; the workers build. Built on mycrew-product + mycrew-worker.
